Add catch block dumping `kubectl get keystone -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions}' | jq`. (CC-0101 REQ-003, REQ-007)
- 2.5 Implement Step 6 (lastTransitionTime monotonicity) — `script` step that: (a) captures T0 via `kubectl get keystone keystone-invariants -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[?(@.type=="DeploymentReady")].lastTransitionTime}'`, (b) `kubectl scale deploy keystone-invariants --replicas=0`, (c) polls every 2s up to 4m for DeploymentReady=False, (d) `kubectl scale deploy keystone-invariants --replicas=1`, (e) polls every 2s up to 4m for DeploymentReady=True and captures T1, (f) asserts `[[ "$T1" > "$T0" ]]` (RFC3339 string compare). (CC-0101 REQ-004, REQ-007)
- 2.6 Implement Step 7 (ConfigMap immutability) — `script` step that: (a) selects the active config CM via `CM=$(kubectl get cm -n openstack -l forge.c5c3.io/config-base=keystone-invariants-config -o name | head -n1)`, exits 1 with 'no immutable ConfigMap found' if empty; (b) runs `kubectl patch "$CM" -n openstack --type=merge -p '{"data":{"keystone.conf":"x"}}' 2>err`; (c) asserts non-zero exit AND `grep -q 'field is immutable' err`; treats zero exit as a hard failure with explicit message. (CC-0101 REQ-005, REQ-007)
